shortDescription: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 17, 2026) - Genesis Goldfields Corp. children: ("Genesis Goldfields" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the appointment of Jasper Mowatt to its Board of Directors, effective November 16, 2026.

Mr. Mowatt is a geologist and mining entrepreneur with over a decade of experience in mineral exploration, project generation and corporate development. He has been involved in the identification, acquisition and advancement of precious, base and critical mineral projects across North America, South America and Africa.

Mr. Mowatt began his career with Schlumberger and Glencore and currently serves as Chief Executive Officer of Canglo Resource Corp., a Canadian mineral exploration company. He is also the founder of Aurex Alpha, Inc., an artificial intelligence-driven mineral exploration company leveraging machine learning, remote sensing and data processing to accelerate mineral discovery.

Mr. Mowatt holds a BSc (Hons) in Geology from the University of Manchester and an MSc in Metals and Energy Finance from Imperial College London. He is a member of the Australasian Institute of Mining and Metallurgy (AusIMM) and the Institute of Materials, Minerals and Mining (IOM3), and is a Qualified Person as defined under National Instrument 43-101.

Richard Macey has resigned from the Board of Directors, effective November 16, 2026. The Company extends its gratitude to Mr. Macey for his contributions and dedicated service, and wishes him great success in his future endeavours.

The Company's Board of Directors has approved the adoption of a share-based compensation plan (the "Plan"), effective November 16, 2026. The Plan provides for the grant of stock options, restricted share rights and deferred share units to eligible directors, officers, employees and service providers of the Company and its designated affiliates, with deferred share units available to eligible directors only. The maximum number of common shares issuable under the Plan is equal to 10% of the Company's issued and outstanding common shares from time to time.

The Plan is intended to assist the Company in attracting, retaining and motivating qualified personnel and to align their interests with those of the Company's shareholders. The Plan is subject to any required approval of the Canadian Securities Exchange and will be presented to the Company's shareholders for approval at the Company's upcoming annual general meeting on December 18, 2026.

(OTC Pink: NEWDF) (FSE: M4K0) is a Canadian gold exploration company focused on Angola. Its flagship asset is the district-scale Ganda Gold Project, a 786 km2 licence in central-western Angola, held by GOLDANGO - Mineração, Lda. Through its wholly owned subsidiary Orenoxe Holdings Corp., the Company holds the right to acquire, by staged earn-in, up to a 70% interest in GOLDANGO, with an option to increase its interest to 90%. The Company is carrying out systematic exploration on the Ganda Gold Project with the aim of opening a new gold district in one of the least-explored gold jurisdictions in Africa.
